items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Johnny Cincere. Bill Johnson was on bass. Johnny Cincere was on guitar.

ctx.x: 1914? Around 14, yeah. Who else was in the band? Did you remember any of the other fellows?
Yeah. Johnny Cincere. Bill Johnson was on bass. Johnny Cincere was on guitar. Yeah. Yeah.
Remember the clarinet player or the trombone who they were?
